parsed.summary: The PR addresses a specific issue with unit conversion but introduces a non-invertible matrix error handling mechanism that may not be comprehensive enough.

issues.description: The PR does not fully resolve the issue of orthogonal unit combinations. It only handles the case where the matrix is non-invertible, but other edge cases or invalid conversions may still occur.
The PR does not include additional tests to verify the behavior of the unit conversion function with various input scenarios, including the specific issue reported.
